channel.description: This is a randomly ordered feed of the most recent entries from summarizedStoriesMainNLscienceAndDiscovery, skipping any feeds with errors.

item.title: Old fossil reveals hidden bones of ancient sea monster
item.description: Fossils collected in Osaka over 30 years ago have yielded four previously unrecognized bones from a giant Cretaceous creature.

item.title: Brain 'switch' explains opposite weight loss effects
item.description: Scientists have discovered why targeting the same brain receptor in different ways can both lead to weight loss, as shown in mice.

item.title: A 60-year-old theory about ants, bees and wasps may be wrong
item.description: Scientists have long thought an unusual genetic system helped ants, bees, and wasps evolve their extraordinary social colonies. A new analysis challenges this idea.

item.title: Common food preservative linked to rising suicide deaths among young people
item.description: A widely available food-preservation chemical is emerging as a disturbing factor in rising UK suicide deaths, particularly among younger people and men.
